summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundle unrelated to the ESLint plugin
details: The tarball adds a preinstall hook (scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs") to what is otherwise a legitimate-looking ESLint plugin (dist/src/index.js). setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses it to execute a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727KB Bun-compiled bundle obfuscated with a rotated string-array decoder (function WV8StW over array n7gIxM, alphabet decoder hc1jfK9) and has no relation to an ESLint plugin. Additional inconsistencies: the version constant V="1.3.13" inside setup.mjs does not match the manifest version 1.3.1, suggesting an injection over a benign upstream. The alternate-runtime dispatch (executing an obfuscated payload under a freshly-downloaded Bun rather than Node) routes install-time code around Node-based inspection. On npm install this results in an obfuscated, non-inspectable payload executing on the installer host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
